bodyHtml:
ROT-1 Reverse Osmosis Tank (3L / 0.8 Gal)

3-Liter (0.8 Gallon) Tank for Drinking Water & RO Systems | Aquasky RO-PLUS Series | Made in Taiwan

ROT-1 is designed specifically for reverse osmosis systems, point-of-use plug and drinking systems, and coffee makers, providing safe, pure, and pressurized water delivery.

 

ROT-1 has a total volume of 3 liters (0.8 gallons). The tank is designed for a maximum operating pressure of 7 bar (100 psi) and a maximum operating temperature of 90 °C (194 °F). It is factory pre-charged to 0.5-0.7 bar (7-10 psi) with 100% nitrogen for stable system performance that remains unaffected by temperature fluctuations.

 

With a diameter of 14.0 cm (5.5 inches) and a height of 19.6 cm (7.7 inches), the compact design makes installation quick and convenient while saving space.

Price InquiryContact us

Product Overview

The ROT-1 is a 3-liter (0.8 gallon) diaphragm pressure tank designed for reverse osmosis (RO) drinking systems, coffee makers, and point-of-use plug systems. It securely stores purified water and delivers it into the system with controlled, robust pressure.

ROT-1 is ideal for regions and applications demanding the highest quality of clean, odor-free drinking water. Its hygienic internal design separates the stored water from the compressed gas and prevents water from making direct contact with the metal tank shell. Utilizing an FDA-approved polypropylene liner and a DIN 4807-compliant butyl rubber diaphragm, the ROT-1 ensures exceptionally safe operation, delivering cleaner, fresher, and better-tasting water while maintaining a tasteless water free zone of any rubber or plastic smells.

Manufactured with premium materials and certified by NSF58, CE, and ISO 9001, Aquasky RO tanks deliver a long service life, dependable performance, and the safest drinking-water compatibility on the market.

Key Features & Design Advantages

  • Epoxy powder exterior for anti-oxidation and fine finish.
  • Stainless-steel, lead-free, chemical-free water connection with Aquasky's patented leak-safe technology (18 years).
  • High-performance butyl rubber diaphragm (DIN 4807).
  • Internal virgin FDA-approved polypropylene liner prevents water contact with metal.
  • Patented leakage-free O-ring sealed air valve cap.
  • 100% factory pre-charged with nitrogen.
  • 100% pressure tested before shipment for reliability.
  • High customization available for distinct market branding.
  • 100% made in Taiwan.

How the RO-PLUS Pressure Tank Works

ROT-1 stores supplemental water securely between the butyl rubber diaphragm and the polypropylene liner, while the nitrogen-filled air chamber maintains constant system pressure. When a drinking tap or coffee maker is activated, the compressed nitrogen pushes the purified water into the system at a controlled pressure.

This specialized design ensures stable performance, completely separates the water from the metal shell, and maintains a clean water zone that is completely free of rubber or plastic odors.

Key benefits

  • Delivers cleaner, fresher, and better-tasting water by isolating the water supply from metals and plastics
  • Provides a tasteless water zone with absolutely no rubber or plastic smells
  • Guarantees zero air loss and exceptional air resistance, outperforming other tanks on the market
  • Completely maintenance-free during its entire expected service life
     

Typical Applications

  • Reverse Osmosis (RO) systems
  • Point-of-use plug and drinking systems
  • Commercial and residential coffee makers

Frequently Asked Question (FAQ)

Q1 : Is the ROT-1 safe for storing my drinking water?

Yes. The ROT-1 uses a high-grade polypropylene liner and a butyl diaphragm made with FDA-approved materials, which completely prevents the water from ever making contact with the metal tank shell. 

This guarantees a tasteless water zone with no rubber or plastic smells, making it perfectly safe for clean drinking water. Furthermore, the stainless steel connector is chemical-free and lead-free.
 

Q2 : Does the ROT-1 require regular maintenance or air recharging?

No. The ROT-1 is designed to be entirely maintenance-free during its service life. We utilize a specialized brass cap with an internal O-ring that guarantees no air loss from the air-vent. 

Additionally, it is the only RO storage tank in the industry pre-charged with 100% Nitrogen, which naturally resists permeation and prevents pressure fluctuations caused by temperature changes
 

Q3 : What makes Aquasky RO tanks the industry standard?

AQUASKY invented the leak-safe technology applied to the stainless connector 18 years ago, setting the benchmark for drinking water tanks. Manufactured in an ISO 9001:2008 registered facility and holding top-tier certifications like NSF58 and CE, it is recognized as one of the safest pressure vessels in the market.
